subject: Intermittent 503s during peak—requesting availability window & credit eligibility
messages:
From: Elaine Frost <elaine.frost@greencart.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom@greencart.com>, GreenCart Ops <ops@greencart.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T09:12:34-07:00
Subject: Intermittent 503s during peak—requesting availability window & credit eligibility

Hi Nikhil,

We saw a significant spike of 503 responses on our checkout API between ~08:46 and ~09:03 PDT this morning (US-west). This impacted roughly 2–3% of checked-out orders during that 17-minute window — we have a handful of failed transactions and multiple merchant complaints.

Sample symptoms: repeated 503s from /v1/checkout/complete, elevated retry rates, and a backlog on the client side that led to timeouts. Our SRE collected a short sample of request IDs but we haven't attached the full traces yet.

Can you confirm the availability/down window on your side, whether this meets the SLA credit eligibility criteria, and what evidence you need from us to proceed with a claim? We're entering renewal conversations and this is time-sensitive.

Thanks — please loop in whoever you need from your side.

Regards,
Elaine Frost
Head of Platform Reliability
GreenCart

Attachments: none in this initial message
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Frost <elaine.frost@greencart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T09:22:11-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s during peak—requesting availability window & credit eligibility

Thanks for the heads-up, Elaine — I'm sorry you saw that today. We're pulling telemetry now. I've looped in Ben (SRE) to lead the incident verification and Marissa from accounts to help with the SLA/renewal context.

A few quick asks so we can validate and scope the claim efficiently:
- Can you attach the trace bundle (full traces for the example request IDs) and a short CSV of request IDs + timestamps?
- Any proxy/gateway logs from GreenCart side (if available) that show the client-side retry pattern would help.
- Approximate count of affected requests (even an estimate is fine).

Ben will give a preliminary impact window within the hour and confirm whether this meets our availability SLO thresholds. Marissa will follow up about the credit process and what documentation you should expect.

We aim to: 1) confirm the exact impacted window, 2) identify root cause or fallback trigger, and 3) share an initial credit eligibility read within 48 hours.

I'll update once we have the first pass.

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Account Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: GreenCart Ops <ops@greencart.com>

Date: 2028-05-09T10:05:02-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s during peak—requesting availability window & credit eligibility

Hi Nikhil / Ben,

Attaching the trace bundle and a short CSV extract with the request IDs we mentioned. The trace bundle filename is greencart_503_traces_20280509.tar.gz. We also uploaded the bundle to the shared drive: https://drive.green-cart.com/share/greencart/trace-bundle-12345 (internal link).

Notes:
- Affected requests concentrated between 08:46:11 and 09:03:17 PDT.
- Approx. 2,700 requests returned 503 during that window according to our edge logs.
- We saw client-side retries bumping up request volume to downstream systems.

We need confirmation as soon as you can — this hit our merchants in the morning peak and the renewal conversation with a large partner is impacted.

Thanks,
Ops Team
GreenCart

Attachments: greencart_503_traces_20280509.tar.gz (attachment), greencart_request_log_excerpt.csv (attachment)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, GreenCart Ops <ops@greencart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T11:03:45-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent 503s during peak—requesting availability window & credit eligibility

Thanks for the bundle — we've started ingesting the traces. Preliminary notes:

- Initial signal suggests a transient autoscaler mis-evaluation combined with a short-lived shard eviction on the serving pool that led to KV cache misses and higher tail-latency.
- I'm seeing elevated rejection (503) counts aligned with the 08:46–09:03 window provided by GreenCart.

Next steps (what we'll do on our side):
1) Run TTL and eviction traces against the attached bundle and our internal metrics to produce a timeline.
2) Cross-reference our routing logs to verify if requests were routed to a degraded serving group.
3) Produce a minimal evidence package (trace excerpts + timeline) for the SLA assessment.

Timing: I can confirm the exact impact window and whether it hits the SLA threshold by EOD today. If it qualifies, we'll prepare the draft credit calculation and the postmortem (RCAs and remediation plan) for delivery within 72 hours.

Permissions request: please confirm GreenCart is okay with us pulling the tenant traces from our retention store for the verification run (we'll only surface aggregated timelines and the request IDs you provided).

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

On Thu, May 9, 2028 at 09:22 AM Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the heads-up, Elaine — I'm sorry you saw that today. We're pulling telemetry now. I've looped in Ben (SRE) to lead the incident verification and Marissa from accounts to help with the SLA/renewal context.
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Frost <elaine.frost@greencart.com>, GreenCart Ops <ops@greencart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed impact window, preliminary eligibility, and next steps

Elaine / Ops / Tom — thanks for your patience. Finalizing the verification after Ben's telemetry run:

- Confirmed impact window: 2028-05-09T08:46:11-07:00 to 2028-05-09T09:03:17-07:00 (UTC-7).
- Affected requests: we corroborated ~2,710 503 responses in that window across the joint traces.
- Root cause (preliminary): a short-lived autoscaler decision caused insufficient warm capacity for the serving shard; when combined with a KV cache local eviction, tail-latency spiked and resulted in 503s.

SLA eligibility read: based on the verified window and our 99.95% availability SLO for the paid tier, this incident meets the threshold for a pro-rata credit. Ben and I will prepare the formal credit calculation (token-based and time-proportional) and Marissa will draft the credit memo for GreenCart.

Deliverables and timeline:
- Evidence bundle for your records: greencart_503_traces_20280509.tar.gz and greencart_request_log_excerpt.csv (attached) — included in this thread.
- Postmortem (RCAs + remediation): targeted delivery within 72 hours (by 2028-05-12T15:45:00-07:00).
- Formal SLA credit offer and invoice adjustment: Marissa will share the draft credit memo by EOD tomorrow.

If you need any changes to the evidence disclosure (e.g., redaction requests), let us know and we'll accommodate.

Again — sincerely sorry for the disruption. We'll follow up with the postmortem and the credit calculation shortly.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
